{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOUDROfM8AAAABXGgDHg", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlR_zzhAqZxw", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlR_z", "number": 105, "title": "Remove verbose instructional footer from extension Live screen", "body": "## Problem

The extension Live window currently displays a long, always-visible instructional footer below the text output. In `extension/recorder.html`, it begins:

> The default shows speech in one Live text display. Replace updates only the preview; each append adds a committed item ...

This mixes detailed graph/runtime documentation into a result-focused screen, creates visual clutter, and makes the Live UI harder to scan. Users should see their results and relevant controls, not a paragraph explaining internal `replace`/`append` semantics.

## Expected outcome

- Remove the **entire long instructional footer** from the Live screen, not just shorten or relocate it to another permanently visible section.
- Keep the Live screen visually focused on configured output regions, Start/Stop/Cancel and other necessary controls, current capture/processing status, and actionable errors. Do not hide or remove important operational feedback.
- Keep detailed `replace`/`append`, session lifecycle, capture-window, and copy-before-close guidance in appropriate Graph Editor help or existing documentation where useful; do not add a new always-visible tutorial, tooltip framework, or unrelated UI redesign.
- Preserve the graph-driven display regions, accessibility of controls/status messages, and all recording, copy, model, and session behavior. This is a small presentation-only change.

## Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] The footer text and its permanently visible instructional container are removed from the packaged Live page.
- [ ] Packaged MV3 or DOM tests verify that Live renders its normal configured display regions, essential controls, status and errors without the removed paragraph.
- [ ] Existing copy, recording lifecycle, graph rendering, and accessibility-related tests remain passing; do not change runtime semantics.
- [ ] Update any UI documentation or screenshots that explicitly show the obsolete footer, if present.
- [ ] Run the applicable extension build and automated tests before merge; report skipped or unrun optional checks accurately.

All mandatory acceptance criteria must be achievable and verifiable before merge.

## Required post-merge verification

None.

## Context

- `extension/recorder.html`, currently line 20: long static `<footer>` beginning `The default shows speech in one Live text display.`
- The Live window is a generic graph-output surface, not a permanent explanation of the default ASR graph.
- Scope: remove the instructional clutter only; do not redesign Graph Editor or change Node/Port behavior.
